cohort: 89 pregnant women (44 with GDM and 45 without GDM) who underwent a 50 g glucose loading test between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Fractalkine (FKN) expression was significantly increased in the capillary endothelium and HUVECs of pregnant women with GDM, and FKN expression was associated with fetal macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia, and preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken between 24-28 weeks of gestation (for GCT), at birth (for placenta samples), and in the neonatal period (for outcomes like hypoglycemia).
gest_age: Participants underwent GCT between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation.
